Problem: Write a python function to set the left most unset bit.

Tests:
assert set_left_most_unset_bit(10) == 14
assert set_left_most_unset_bit(12) == 14
assert set_left_most_unset_bit(15) == 15

Write the t task named `set_left_most_unset_bit` with 1 parameter(s) of type(s) int, in the order the tests pass them, returning int. The tests must pass and the ensures must specify the result.
